notes.title: Introducing “Elliot,” an intelligent, calm and collected aide.
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174568/07a8efda50d22f8b002ae66f1f7a3c68371ea51f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The character Elliot from "The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom" is an intelligent, calm, and composed character who serves as the excellent aide to Aquasteed.

🛡️𝓔𝓵𝓵𝓲𝓸𝓽 🛡️

As Aquasteed’s assistant, Elliot calmly handles his duties with poise. His strong sense of responsibility and stoic attitude, always striving for perfection, is truly captivating.

However, his occasional sharp-tongued but witty exchanges, and the sight of him enjoying time with his comrades, reveal a charming side that makes you smile.
Moreover, when it comes to romance, he has a somewhat oblivious and awkward side. Despite being the perfect aide, seeing him struggle with love tugs at your heart and makes you want to know his true feelings more.
That very gap between his perfect professionalism and his vulnerability in love is what makes him so incredibly attractive.

The voice actor for "Elliot" is Sho Karino. He has voiced many popular characters, such as Yukihiro Kamiya in THE IDOLM@STER SideM and Chifuyu Matsuno in Tokyo Revengers.

Check out his sample voice on the website:
🔗  [url="https://akuyaku.operahouse.co.jp/chara_05.html"]https://akuyaku.operahouse.co.jp/chara_05.html[/url][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the mysterious fairy king “Crail”
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174568/00e27998119399835e605bbf3d92d8f464544960.jpg[/img]

The character "Crail" from The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom is a fairy king with a mysterious charm. 


☁️ 𝓒𝓻𝓪𝓲𝓵 ☁️

As a fairy king, Crail possesses immense power, yet he doesn’t flaunt it, quietly watching over the world. His composed demeanor is like the gentle moon on a calm night, and the kindness he occasionally shows stirs something deep within your heart.

While he rarely speaks of love, his deep feelings subtly emerge in the way he expresses himself. You find yourself wanting to understand the true meaning behind every word he says, and before you know it, you’re drawn to him. His otherworldly beauty and graceful movements create the regal presence of a fairy king. Yet, within that, the glimpses of human warmth pull you in even more.

With overwhelming dignity and nurturing strength, and an elusive, mysterious charm, you’ll find that once you’re captivated, you can’t take your eyes off him.

The voice actor for "Crail" is Hikaru Midorikawa. He has voiced many popular characters, such as Heero Yuy in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing and Seto Kaiba in YU-GI-OH!.

Check out his sample voice on the website:
🔗  https://akuyaku.operahouse.co.jp/chara_08.html

notes.title: Introducing “Keith,” the free-spirited fairy king
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174568/847ad37f709f335bb436536ced105f365a5f69a5.jpg[/img]

The character Keith from "The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom" is someone whose charm lies in living freely and naturally.

🌿 𝓚𝓮𝓲𝓽𝓱 🌿

He has the approachable demeanor of an older brother, yet when he shows a sudden mature kindness, your heart races. The moment you notice the deep compassion hidden behind his lighthearted remarks, you realize he's actually a genuine person.

Despite being a fairy king, Keith treats humans as equals and lives freely. His mysterious charm hidden behind his carefree oresama attitude makes it impossible to look away. And then, there’s the contrast when he shows serious expressions or a shy side, which steals your heart, and before you know it, you’re captivated by him.

The voice actor for "Keith" in this work is Junichi Suwabe. He has voiced many popular characters, such as Keigo Atobe in The Prince of Tennis and Archer in Fate/stay night.

Check out his sample voice on the website:
🔗  https://akuyaku.operahouse.co.jp/chara_07.html

notes.title: Introducing “ Hartknights,” the crown prince with a hidden charm
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174568/df5cc95654f90f94c700c7a7ff0ac621b64b5da0.jpg[/img]

Let us introduce you to Hartknights, a handsome and captivating character from "The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom".

🗡️ 𝑯𝒂𝒓𝒕𝒌𝒏𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕𝒔 🗡️

Hartknights, who behaves calmly and dignified as the crown prince, is the ideal prince—intellectual and graceful. His resolute demeanor reflects a strong will and sense of responsibility, looking ahead to the future of the country. However, his charm doesn’t end there.

By choosing to let go of his fiancée, Tiararose, he reveals a side of himself as a young man confused by love. As he is tossed around by a new romance, glimpses of his immaturity and inner conflict show that he’s not just a simple antagonist, but a truly captivating figure. 

When you touch his pure and sincere feelings, his true charm shines.

The voice actor who plays "Hartknights" is Takuya Sato. 

He has voiced many popular characters, such as Tsunashi Ryunosuke in IDOLiSH7 and Shokudaikiri Mitsutada in Touken Ranbu.

Check out his sample voice on the website:
🔗  https://akuyaku.operahouse.co.jp/chara_02.html

notes.title: Introducing the handsome crown prince “Aquasteed”.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174568/eeaf983922d33414921e05a295cbf636815af7a5.jpg[/img]

Who wouldn’t want to fall in love with Aquasteed from "The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom"?  
Let me introduce you to this dreamy character today 🩵

Aquasteed 👑

He’s the prince from the neighboring kingdom, Marinforest, studying abroad in the kingdom of Lapis Lazuli. Aquasteed is a smart and calm prince, but when it comes to his beloved Tiararose, he’s incredibly sweet and devoted. His gentle love and the kindness that shines through his words are like a dream come true for all otome lovers 🥲💕

With his noble heart, gentlemanly charm, and unshakable devotion to Tiararose, he’s the epitome of the perfect prince. His love for her is so pure and passionate, you can't help but be swept off your feet.

The VA for our Prince Aquaseed is Yuuichiro Umehara, also known as Keito Hasumi from Ensemble Stars!! or Leona Kingscholar from Disney Twisted-Wonderland.

Check out his sample voice on the website:
🔗  https://akuyaku.operahouse.co.jp/chara_01.html
